'''Grazers''' were antlered herbivores who were native to the plains and [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]]. Grazers lived together in massive herds, migrating at a ponderous pace across Ammuud, eating [[Grass/Legends|grass]], scrub and [[Lichen/Legends|lichen]]. The shaggy beasts were extremely large&mdash;the smallest adult grazer weighed at least four times that of a full-grown [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]&mdash;and were sometimes preyed upon by Ammuud's native [[pterosaur]]s, who attacked the slowest and weakest in a grazer herd from above. The grazers were quick to stampede when startled by a loud noise or a pterosaur attack, turning their plodding march into something swift and dangerous. One such stampede nearly trampled the Wookiee [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] on a visit to Ammuud in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], although he narrowly managed to escape using a glider crudely fashioned out of a pterosaur's corpse.<ref name="hsr" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grazers first appeared in ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'', a novel written by [[Brian Daley]] and released in [[1979]].<ref name="hsr" />
